body.heading: Where in the world is Burundi?
paragraphs: Burundi is a country in Eastern Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Burundi is Gitega.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Burundi speak Rundi and French.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Burundi is the Burundian franc.

body.heading: How big is Burundi?
paragraphs: Burundi covers about 28,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Togo.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Lake Tanganyika is one of the deepest, longest lakes on Earth. Near Bujumbura its sandy beaches are a favourite place to swim, picnic and watch fishing boats.
Kibira is a cool mountain rainforest of tall trees and tea fields, home to monkeys and hundreds of birds — a green escape above the lake.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Burundi on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Burundi in one breath: a country in Eastern Africa, capital Gitega, where people speak Rundi and pay with the Burundian franc.
